title: Odrive based electric motor dynamometer
license: GPL-3.0 repository license. The data directory has no separate license statement. Included below are original descriptive statistics and source references.
evidence: Full Git CSV objects and logger, sensor conversion and parameter code read at fixed commit. Run header dated 2019-05-11.
queries: open source robot actuator dynamometer testbench data logs motor output torque github load cell quasi direct drive characterization dataset
GitHub robot actuator motor dynamometer transmission efficiency torque sensor harmonic cycloidal test data CSV robot gear actuator benchmark
findings: Both odrive_data.csv paths are one 106043-byte Git object. All 344 data rows have 19 finite fields. Absorber measuring-arm load-cell torque ranges from −1457.2 to −0.4 N mm.

The 41 distinct test-motor speed setpoints are positive. The opposing absorber encoder has negative speed in 343/344 rows. Raw signs and encoder endpoints are retained. All input-current and input-power entries are zero.
limits: load-cell torque is mechanical reaction torque on the absorber pivot arm; source conversion uses 0.1 m lever. The two sides have different encoder definitions.

No time stamp per row or unrestricted/limited torque pair. The logger queries each field in turn, then takes the arithmetic mean of ten readings. Input power in this CSV cannot support pointwise electrical efficiency.
A repository preliminary test table; no calibration uncertainty certificate or independent dynamic clock alignment verified.
